CRM fragment: product + technical fit notes
- Company: SilkStack AI — early-stage but shipping JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that does local workspace indexing + online completion.
- Primary ask: backend inference that feels 'native' to IDE: sub-50ms token latency for inline completions, streaming support for character-level suggestions, and model/version pinning per release channel.
- Architecture intent: plugin builds and stores a local index (file-level embeddings) for fuzzy matches and to reduce calls; runtime should call Redwood for heavy gen/completion and fall back to quantized local model when offline. Hybrid/offline-first requirement.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), enterprise audit logs, KMS for key management, and US data residency for corporate customers. SOC2 required for procurement.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — want predictable committed pricing (Dedicated) for scale; willing to evaluate Private if on-prem/VPC ops are straightforward.
- SE feedback from 2026-02-03 call: streaming prototype with Redwood produced lower CPU on client but had bursts at token boundary. Need kernel/packer advice for 4k context model; asked about continuous batching and KV sharing across user sessions.
- Quote from CTO (Paraphrased): "Plugin must feel native to IntelliJ — no perceptible lag mid-typing. If it slows dev flow we lose users fast."
- Integration asks: plugin sandboxing in JetBrains, offline cache eviction policy, model pin + automatic fallback (e.g., gpt-small-quant -> gpt-medium), SDK for Kotlin/Java plugin integration, and example rate-limiting tiers for burst typing patterns.
- Legal: sent security questionnaire link; awaiting answers to HSM/KMS details and subprocessor list. Procurement wants a TCO spreadsheet comparing Dedicated vs Private for 12/24 month commits.
- POC scope proposed: 2-week integration with sample IntelliJ project (Scala/Java/Kotlin), measure median token latency, CPU/memory on dev machines, and fallback reliability when offline.
- Internal champions: CTO (Anika Bose) and Head of Product (Marco Ruiz). AE asked to schedule engineering-to-engineering SE session week of 2026-02-22.
- Notes style: shorthand bullets, snippets of email threads. Follow-ups: send quantization guidance doc + short demo of streaming SDK for JetBrains plugin authors.
